findings.title: Page-30 Advance component evidence clips the left cyan arrowhead
findings.description: The Advance panel has two cyan curved arrows. The arrows detail uses [104,345,141,476] points, cutting off the head and upper curve of the left arrow. Fresh original pixel [188,734] at 144 DPI is cyan [42,197,244] (PDF point [94,367]); it lies outside every one of the seven Advance detail-component boxes. A bounded 12x13-point source window contains 77 such cyan pixels. The same incomplete boundary is frozen in final-verified and both replays. Primary field tiles retain these pixels, so this is incomplete component accounting/evidence, not lost whole-page pixels or denominator inflation.
findings.consequence: The complete-component/fresh exact evidence and complete-replay claims are stronger than the authored component set. The verifier compares keys to SPECS and cannot catch this truncated source component.
